**CHR-1257 phase 2a, Stitch chrome (2026-11-27, awaiting Christian's approval).** The agent presented screens (`set_board_state`), so the browser switched to the Board. A floating status pill above the zoom pill says "The agent switched you to the Board to show 5 screens" with a violet agent dot and a Dismiss button (flows to `board-view`). The board state the agent set is visible in the nav card ("5 shown by the agent", filter and pins) and in the Agent bar feed ("Put 5 screens on the Board for you"). The tab switch itself is not a flow (tool-driven, not a click). The pill is a one-off and stays inline.

Earlier notes (history):

CHR-618/CHR-621 ticket state 6: the browser switches to the Board tab when an agent presents screens (standing decision, not modelled as an Artisign flow since it is a tool-driven UI transition, not a user click). Shows a dismissible pill banner (\"Agent switched you here to show 3 screens\") positioned inside the canvas, clearly below the toolbar's bottom border (not overlapping it — first version straddled the border and read as misplaced chrome rather than an intentional overlay). All three tiles carry the unpinned `default` `$pin-button` — none is pinned here, demonstrating the affordance's resting state, not just its pinned state. No new component for the banner: this is a one-off, not a repeated pattern yet, so it is built directly from `$color.accent`/`$spacing`/`$radius.pill` tokens rather than promoted — promote it if a second occurrence appears.
